name: veo-match-analytics
description: Extract verified Veo analytics and exact event markers, then save confirmed fixture, player, and raw-video event data to Supabase.

interface.shortDescription: Save Veo analytics and raw-video event links
interface.longDescription: Open a Veo match analysis URL in the browser, pause for sign-in when required, inspect page-observed analytics, event, and media requests, confirm the ClubATX fixture, corrected side mapping, official score, Veo-authoritative half duration, athlete links, event-link pre-roll, and destructive event replacement, then atomically persist and verify match analytics, cumulative event minutes, consolidated player statistics, exact playing-time seconds, and supported player events linked to the raw MP4 recording with a 3-second playback pre-roll by default.
defaultPrompt: Extract and save analytics from this Veo match URL
Import exact player playing times from this Veo match
Import player events with raw-video links and a 3-second pre-roll from this Veo match
